title: Leaving MacBook Plugged In
read: One more tip for a new machine: let it run through a full charge cycle in the first week or two so the battery indicator calibrates — otherwise, just use it normally.
new macbook. is it bad to leave it plugged in 24/7

Not really — modern MacBooks manage this for you.

* **Optimized Battery Charging** (on by default) learns your routine and holds the charge at **80%** when it expects you to stay plugged in, finishing to 100% just before you usually unplug.
* On Apple silicon Macs you can check it under **System Settings → Battery → (i) next to Battery Health**.
* Heat is the bigger enemy than being plugged in. Avoid using it on a bed/couch under heavy load for long periods.

If you're plugged in nearly all the time at a desk, the built-in behavior is enough. Third-party apps that cap charge at e.g. 80% exist, but they're optional.
